    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Headers are real buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the body
      - listitem: Closed bodies are inert, so they can't be focused or read until opened
      - listitem: "A polite live region per card announces \"search_web running\", \"finished\" or \"failed: …\"; the group announces \"Using tools…\" and \"Used 3 tools\""
      - listitem: Copy buttons are labelled "Copy arguments" / "Copy result" and switch to "Copied"; icons are aria-hidden
      - listitem: Errors use text and an icon, not only red
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The body grows with grid-template-rows 0fr → 1fr and fades in; the chevron turns
      - listitem: Status changes blur in; the blue check pops in and draws itself; the spinner turns while running
      - listitem: The small white copy button morphs into a blue check for 1.4s; Show all opens the capped block to its full height
      - listitem: In the group, new tool icons pop into the stack of small white tiles and "Using tools…" shimmers while anything runs
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly and the shimmer is off
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container; name and summary truncate with an ellipsis, the status never wraps – works down to ~320px
      - listitem: Each call is one white card with hairline shadows; tighter padding below 360px and taller headers on touch screens
      - listitem: Code wraps long lines instead of scrolling sideways
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: "Map your agent's tool-call events 1:1: status running on the call, success or error on the result; pass startedAt from the event for an exact timer"
      - listitem: Write summary in past tense when done ("Searched…") and present progressive while running ("Searching…")
      - listitem: Pass args and result as objects – stringify nothing yourself; redact secrets before they reach the card
      - listitem: Wrap all calls of one assistant turn in a single ToolCallGroup and keep cards as direct children
